title: Vinted CEO Thomas Plantenga says the Lithuania-based secondhand retailer plans to spend tens of millions of dollars to expand in the US in the coming months (Aimee Look/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Aimee Look / Wall Street Journal: Vinted CEO Thomas Plantenga says the Lithuania-based secondhand retailer plans to spend tens of millions of dollars to expand in the US in the coming months — CEO Thomas Plantenga says the startup is pouring tens of millions of dollars into efforts to expand in the U.S. over the next few months
